args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Trip Dates: June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES (June 11, 12, 18):
- Beach towels
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Beach bag
- Water bottle

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES (June 13, 15):
- Sturdy hiking shoes/boots
- Hiking socks
- Lightweight, moisture-wicking shirts
- Quick-dry pants/shorts
- Backpack/daypack
- Insect repellent
- Sun hat
- Trail snacks

SIGHTSEEING & CULTURAL ACTIVITIES (June 14, 16, 19):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Modest clothing for Pearl Harbor visit
- Light sweater for evening luau
- Small backpack for day trips
- Umbrella or light rain jacket (for possible showers)

PERSONAL CARE:
- Toiletries (travel-sized)
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hair ties/clips
- Makeup (optional)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/e-reader for relaxation days (June 17, 20)
- Travel pillow for flights
- Reusable shopping bags (for Ala Moana shopping on June 19)
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes
- Small travel umbrella

REMINDERS:
- Check weather forecast before departure
- Verify hotel amenities (hair dryer, iron, etc.)
- Download offline maps of Hawaii
- Save emergency contacts in phone
